Third-party components
----------------------
  - KiCadRoutingTools/ (external autorouter) is a separate, independent
    open-source project by Andy Haas (drandyhaas), licensed under the MIT
    License — see KiCadRoutingTools/LICENSE. It is bundled here
    unmodified for convenience only. You may update or rebuild that
    folder independently of Alladin. It is not part of the Alladin
    source repository.

  - Silkscreen stroke font: Hershey Futural (Simplex Roman). Originally
    created by Dr. A. V. Hershey (U.S. NBS); distribution format by
    James Hurt (Cognition, Inc.). See docs/hershey-USE_RESTRICTION.txt.
